name: BSP_MParatrooper_IsKindOf
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Class test in vtable slot 5Ch for class id 31h. Decoded from the raw .text bytes (Ghidra has no function here): MOV EAX,[ESP+4], a run of CMP EAX,imm over the ancestor chain 31 2A 02 01 00 with the root compare emitted as TEST EAX,EAX, then CMP EAX,[ECX+0C4h] for the dynamic class id, RET 4 returning 0 or 1. Installed in vtable(s) 00D05060. Parent id 2A. Class name MParatrooper recovered from 007AC4C0. See docs/ENTITY_CLASS_IDS.md.

name: BSP_Entity_PathInterfaceForKind
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc_ship_ai_arms, read-only analysis. __fastcall(entity), RET 0, body 007AC9D0-007ACA2C, complete. A fixed-offset interface cast by entity kind: vtable[5Ch](47h) or (4Ah) -> entity+1E4h, (48h) -> entity+170h, (49h) -> entity+310h, otherwise 0; a null entity returns 0 at 007AC9D5. The three offsets are secondary bases of docs/UNIT_INSTANCE_UPDATE.md. Its only read call site is 00816FA7 in 00816E30, where a non-zero answer rewrites a moveto (00E08F68) into a moveonpath (00E08F80). docs/ENTITY_COMMAND_ARMS.md

name: BSP_EntityCommand_SlotHasNoLegs
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc_ai_goal_vector, read-only analysis. bool __thiscall(slot)(void), RET, body 007ADC30-007ADC50, sole call site 009E59F8 in BSP_ShipAi_MoveOnPathStateStep. 007ADC33-007ADC3E is the compiler's slot+4h != 0 test written as NEG/SBB/TEST; with a command it calls vtable[0Ch] at 007ADC45 and answers false at 007ADC4B only when the count is positive, true at 007ADC4E otherwise. It is the head of 007ADC60 BSP_EntityCommand_IsOnFinalLeg without that routine's cursor tests, so it means no legs at all, not the last leg. docs/SHIP_AI_GOAL_VECTOR.md

name: BSP_EntityCommand_IsOnFinalLeg
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc_ship_ai_state_steps, read-only analysis. __thiscall(slot)(), RET 0, body 007ADC60-007ADCBD, read complete, where slot is what 0071BFF0 returns. True when slot+4h is null (007ADC71) or its vtable[0Ch] count is not positive (007ADC7A); false when slot+0Ch is not 1; with mode 1 it is true when slot+8h is count-1 and the reverse byte slot+10h is set, or when slot+8h is 0 and it is clear. Its result is what 009E5770, 009E59C0 and 009E1610 pass to 009DE050 as the final-leg flag that reaches blk+1E4h and 009EE6DE. docs/SHIP_AI_STATE_STEPS.md
